label: Notion: Create Database Item
description: Add a row to a Notion database. Properties are Notion property-value JSON keyed by column name.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Notion access (wire a NotionAccess node).

inputs.name: database
inputs.label: Database
inputs.placeholder: Paste the database's link or id

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Source
inputs.placeholder: Only needed when the database has several sources

inputs.name: properties
inputs.description: The row's columns as Notion property values, e.g. { "Name": { "title": [{ "text": { "content": "Task" } }] } }.
